title: The Rights of Children over Parents in Tarbiyah and Education
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, mentioning that among the child’s rights are that their name be chosen well, that they be taught writing and reading, and that they be taught the prayer. It also highlights the importance of raising children with good akhlaq (morals) and teaching them acts of worship.

review_defects.why: Inconsistent transliteration: the title transliterates 'Tarbiyah' but the body translates the same Arabic term as 'raising'. Islamic term should be handled consistently.
Islamic term 'salah' is translated away as 'prayer' instead of being transliterated, while other terms like 'akhlaq' are transliterated. Inconsistent treatment of Islamic terminology.
